summary.text: Mike Mueller is a Republican member of the Michigan House of Representatives from District 72 who is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election; Ballotpedia lists his service in the House as beginning in 2019.
A Navy veteran and business owner from Linden, he previously worked as a road patrol deputy and SWAT team member.

paragraphs.text: Mueller lives in Linden, Michigan, graduated from Linden High School in 1992, and served in the U.S. Navy.
He earned a degree in criminology and criminal justice from Eastern Michigan University.
His career includes operating Mueller's Orchard and Cider Mill, owning a wedding venue, and working as a road patrol deputy and SWAT team member.
Mueller has chaired the House Government Operations Committee and served as majority vice chair of the Judiciary Committee in the 2021-2022 session.
In the 2025-2026 session he serves on the House Appropriations Committee.
He advanced from the August 4, 2026 Republican primary and faces Democrat Thomas Ryan in the general election on November 3, 2026.
